name: Pretend To Love End Up Obsessed
original_name: Pretend To Love End Up Obsessed
overview: Lawyer Sofía Yanis uses her boss as an excuse to fake a confession during a blind date... without knowing that he is listening to her. A misunderstanding leads them to an express marriage. Between limits, tension and games of seduction, she ends up overcoming her boss's coldness and finding a unique love.
